# Oxford University Press
> Oxford University Press publishes research, education, language learning, reference, and music resources for global academic and professional audiences.

Oxford University Press moves knowledge and learning forward through academic publishing, educational products, English language teaching, dictionaries, and corporate news and community initiatives.

## Corporate
- [Homepage](https://oup.com/): Oxford University Press corporate homepage with portfolio highlights, news, and links to major publishing divisions.
- [Purpose & Values](https://corp.oup.com/purpose-and-values/): Overview of OUP’s mission, principles, and commitment to education and research.
- [History & Accolades](https://corp.oup.com/history-and-accolades/): Background on OUP’s history, heritage, and notable achievements.
- [News & Insight](https://corp.oup.com/news-and-insight/): Corporate news, commentary, and publishing insights from Oxford University Press.
- [Community & Events](https://corp.oup.com/community-and-events/): Information on OUP community programs, partnerships, and public events.

## Research & Professional
- [Academic Platform](https://global.oup.com/academic): Main entry point for academic and professional books, journals, and online resources.
- [Higher Education](https://global.oup.com/academic/higher-education): Textbooks and learning resources for university and college teaching.
- [Dictionaries & Reference](https://global.oup.com/academic/category/dictionaries-and-reference): Academic reference works, dictionaries, and encyclopedic resources across disciplines.
- [Sheet Music](https://global.oup.com/academic/category/arts-and-humanities/sheet-music): Printed and digital music publications for performers, teachers, and institutions.
- [Arts & Humanities](https://global.oup.com/academic/category/arts-and-humanities): Academic books and resources in literature, history, philosophy, and related fields.
- [Social Sciences](https://global.oup.com/academic/category/social-sciences): Scholarly publishing in politics, economics, law, sociology, and related disciplines.
- [Science & Mathematics](https://global.oup.com/academic/category/science-and-mathematics): Books and resources in scientific, technical, and mathematical subjects.
- [Medicine & Health](https://global.oup.com/academic/category/medicine-and-health): Clinical, medical, and health sciences publishing for professionals and researchers.

## Education
- [Education](https://global.oup.com/education/): Overview of school and classroom learning products from Oxford University Press.
- [Primary](https://global.oup.com/education/content/primary/): Teaching and learning resources for primary school settings.
- [Secondary](https://global.oup.com/education/content/secondary/): Curriculum-aligned materials and support for secondary education.
- [Assessment](https://global.oup.com/education/content/assessment/): Assessment tools and services for measuring learner progress.
- [Professional Development](https://global.oup.com/education/content/professional-development/): Training and support resources for teachers and school leaders.

## English Language Teaching
- [ELT Home](https://elt.oup.com/): Oxford English Language Teaching platform for learners, teachers, and institutions.
- [Adult & Young Adult](https://elt.oup.com/catalogue/items/global/adult_elt): English language learning materials for adult and young adult students.
- [Children](https://elt.oup.com/catalogue/items/global/children): English teaching resources designed for younger learners.
- [Teenagers](https://elt.oup.com/catalogue/items/global/teenagers): Course materials and support for teenage English learners.
- [Teacher Resources](https://elt.oup.com/teachers/): Teaching support, classroom resources, and professional guidance for ELT educators.
- [Learning Resources Bank](https://elt.oup.com/learning_resources): Downloadable and digital resources supporting English language learning.

## Dictionaries & Languages
- [Oxford Languages](https://languages.oup.com/): Home for Oxford dictionaries, language data, and lexical resources.
- [Oxford English Dictionary](https://www.oed.com/): Historical dictionary of English with detailed definitions, etymologies, and quotations.
- [Oxford Languages API](https://developer.oxforddictionaries.com/): Developer access to Oxford dictionary data and language APIs.
- [Oxford Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/): Learner-focused English dictionaries and usage resources.
- [Word of the Year](https://languages.oup.com/word-of-the-year/): Annual Oxford Languages feature highlighting culturally significant vocabulary.

## Journals & Online Research
- [Oxford Academic](https://academic.oup.com/): Platform for OUP journals, books, and online scholarly content.
- [Journals](https://academic.oup.com/journals): Browse Oxford University Press academic journals by subject and title.
- [Books](https://academic.oup.com/books): Discover scholarly books and online monographs on Oxford Academic.
- [Subjects](https://academic.oup.com/subjects): Explore Oxford Academic content organized by discipline and topic.
- [Open Access](https://academic.oup.com/journals/pages/open_access): Information about OUP open access publishing options for journals.
- [Author Resources](https://academic.oup.com/journals/pages/for_authors): Guidance for journal authors on submission, policies, and publishing workflows.

## Platforms & Reference Services
- [Oxford Reference](https://www.oxfordreference.com/): Trusted reference platform with dictionaries, encyclopedias, and subject companions.
- [Oxford Bibliographies](https://www.oxfordbibliographies.com/): Expert-curated bibliographies guiding research across academic disciplines.
- [Oxford Research Encyclopedias](https://oxfordre.com/): Continuously updated scholarly encyclopedias written and reviewed by experts.
- [Oxford Scholarship Online](https://www.oxfordscholarship.com/): University press monographs and academic books in a searchable online library.
- [Oxford Law Trove](https://www.oxfordlawtrove.com/): Online law textbooks and learning resources for students and instructors.
- [Oxford Medicine Online](https://oxfordmedicine.com/): Medical books and reference works for clinicians, students, and researchers.
- [Oxford Clinical Psychology](https://www.oxfordclinicalpsych.com/): Clinical psychology books, handbooks, and reference content online.

## News, Insights & Community
- [News & Insight](https://corp.oup.com/news-and-insight/): Corporate articles, announcements, and thought leadership from OUP.
- [Community & Events](https://corp.oup.com/community-and-events/): Community initiatives, campaigns, and event-related updates.
- [Latest Thinking](https://corp.oup.com/news-and-insight/): Recent perspectives and commentary on education, research, and publishing.
- [Oxford Big Read](https://corp.oup.com/community-and-events/): Community-facing reading and literacy initiatives highlighted by OUP.
- [London Book Fair](https://corp.oup.com/community-and-events/): Event-related updates and participation in major publishing gatherings.

## Careers
- [Careers](https://jobs.oup.com/): Job search, recruitment information, and career opportunities across Oxford University Press.
- [Search Jobs](https://jobs.oup.com/search-jobs): Browse current vacancies by role, location, and business area.
- [Early Careers](https://jobs.oup.com/early-careers): Information for graduates, interns, and early-career applicants.
- [Working at OUP](https://jobs.oup.com/working-at-oup): Overview of workplace culture, benefits, and employee experience.
- [Locations](https://jobs.oup.com/locations): Explore OUP office locations and regional opportunities.
